product.name: Monoprice Blade for Punch-Down Impact Tool 66 Type
product.description: This is a replacement blade for Punch-Down Impact tools.  It features dual 66 type tips.  One side has a built-in cutter.  The other side is the standard blade without the cutter. Compatible with punch down impact tools that feature sure-lock blade holders.Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
